## Course overview

Before a model can be trained, before a feature vector can be computed, before
making any prediction — data must move. It must be collected, cleaned,
transformed, validated, and delivered reliably. Data engineering is that
discipline.

This intensive training program prepares Data Engineers, AI Engineers, and AI
Practitioners to build modern, scalable, secure, and production-ready data
architectures that support Artificial Intelligence systems, real-time data
pipelines, vector databases, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and
intelligent analytics platforms.

It gives you a complete mental model of modern data engineering for AI
systems: how pipelines are designed, where they break, what patterns
experienced engineers use to make them reliable, and how the data layer
connects to every other part of the ML system.

## Target audience

- Data Engineers
- Data Scientists interested in production AI pipelines
- Systems Architects
- Technical Team Leads and AI Architects
- Data Infrastructure Administrators

## Key learning outcomes

- Design and implement Data Lakehouse architectures using Delta Lake.
- Build robust real-time data pipelines for streaming applications.
- Implement vector databases and advanced RAG engineering for generative AI
  models.
- Apply automated data governance, quality frameworks, and lineage tracking.
- Integrate components into a scalable data infrastructure via a
  production-simulated capstone project.

## Training methodology

| Component | Share |
|---|---|
| Theory | 25% (1.5 hours) |
| Labs | 50% (3 hours, directed) |
| Review | 25% (1.5 hours, feedback/review) |

## Technical requirements

- **Hardware:** Intel i5/M1, 16GB RAM (minimum) — i7/M2, 32GB RAM (preferred)
- **Software:** Python 3.11+, Docker Desktop, VS Code, cloud access (preferred)
